def csStage (p : Loc) (c : ConfStateM) (done : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  if done = true then iprop(∃ c', csPts p (DFrac.own 1) c' true ∗ ⌜SortedOf c c'⌝) else ownCSM p (DFrac.own 1) c

def SortedOf (c c' : ConfStateM) : Prop :=
  c.lists.Perm c'.lists ∧
    SortedW64 c'.Voters' ∧
      SortedW64 c'.Learners' ∧ SortedW64 c'.VotersOutgoing' ∧ SortedW64 c'.LearnersNext' ∧ c'.AutoLeave' = c.AutoLeave'
